subject: Service continuity follow-up — accountability sprint & customer brief
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@horizonpay.com>
Cc: HorizonPay Security <security@horizonpay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 1 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Service continuity follow-up — accountability sprint & customer brief

Hi Liam and HorizonPay Security team,

Thanks again for the patience while we completed our internal verification. This thread is a concise, customer-facing summary of what we found, the timeline we validated, and the concrete actions we're committing to over the next 30/60/90 days. We attach a compact timeline and the logs we've redacted for review (see attachments).

High-level summary (TL;DR)
- What happened: a misrouted request path combined with an unexpected cache eviction caused elevated tokenization latency for a subset of requests to your tenant pool between 2028-06-29 03:04:00 UTC and 2028-06-29 03:26:00 UTC.
- Impact: Elevated tail latency for ~0.7% of requests resulting in delayed responses; we confirmed no customer data exfiltration and no replicated writes or billing errors.
- Root cause (summary): a recent config change to the autoscaling routing rules introduced a race condition during scale-down, which in conjunction with a KV-cache compaction routine resulted in cache lookup misses and degraded latency for affected connections.

Timeline (short) — full timeline in attached spreadsheet:
- 2028-06-29 03:02 UTC: Autoscaler initiates scale-down of a dedicated shard to reduce idle GPUs.
- 03:04 UTC: Routing table update in control plane overlaps with in-flight inference sessions; some sessions were briefly routed to a warm but not-warmed KV cache node.
- 03:05–03:26 UTC: Elevated 99.9th percentile latency observed for HorizonPay tenant; automatic fallback to compatible model variant reduced throughput but did not fully mitigate latency for a cohort of sessions.
- 03:27 UTC: Autoscaling roll-forward and immediate corrective rule applied; latency returned to baseline.

Immediate customer-facing actions we have taken (complete):
- Stabilized routing rules and reverted the unsafe autoscale flag that triggered the race.
- Applied a short-term mitigation to pin KV-cache replicas for active sessions for 10 minutes post-roll.
- Uploaded the redacted logs and a compact timeline to the shared Drive link above.

Action commitments (owners & ETA)
- 30 days: Deploy a conservative autoscale gating policy and additional test coverage to eliminate the race condition (Owner: Neha Kapoor).
- 60 days: Ship a KV-cache compaction safeguard that will avoid compaction while sessions are migrating (Owner: Dylan Brooks).
- 90 days: Add tenant-aware canary controls so high-sensitivity tenants (like HorizonPay) can opt into stricter post-scale stability windows (Owner: Marissa Cole).

What we ask from you
- Please review the attached timeline and redacted logs. If you would like deeper packet-level artifacts we can provide an expanded bundle under an NDA amendment; let us know.
- Confirm whether you want us to accelerate the 30-day gating policy to an immediate (1-week) hotfix for your account — we can schedule a short maintenance window.

Attachments: service-timeline.xlsx (short timeline), evidence-logs.tar.gz (redacted request logs), customer-communication-draft.docx (technical appendix).

We will follow up with a technical appendix this afternoon that contains the annotated event trace and the code change that introduced the regression.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Senior Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@horizonpay.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
Cc: HorizonPay Security <security@horizonpay.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Jul 2028 10:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Service continuity follow-up — accountability sprint & customer brief

Thanks Tessa — appreciate the quick summary. A couple quick clarifying questions before we loop in our internal compliance team:

1) You mention no customer data exfiltration — can you confirm whether any request payloads were written to non-tenant logs during the window?
2) Can you provide the exact UTC timestamps for the requests that experienced the tail latency so we can correlate with our internal traces?

On the mitigation side, we'd like to request the 30-day gating policy be accelerated to a 7-day hotfix for HorizonPay only. We can provide a short maintenance window on the weekend if that helps.

Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform Reliability
HorizonPay

On Sun, Jul 1, 2028 at 09:12 AM Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Hi Liam and HorizonPay Security team,
> 
> Thanks again for the patience while we completed our internal verification...
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 1 Jul 2028 10:25:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: HorizonPay follow-up — timestamps, logs, and hotfix request

Team — forwarding HorizonPay's clarifying questions. Quick asks:

- Neha: confirm exact UTC request IDs and the list of affected session IDs; include whether any request payloads were copied to debug-only logs during the window (we redacted what we uploaded, but we need a firm answer for Liam).
- Dylan: estimate effort to prioritize the 30-day gating policy as a 7-day hotfix for a single tenant and what risks that creates for other autoscale flows. If feasible, include proposed maintenance window options.
- Marissa: prepare a short customer-facing timeline appendix and a one-page statement about data handling for the compliance team. Keep language non-technical.

Please reply with firm ETA for each bullet by 16:00 PT today; Liam requested acceleration and we should respond promptly.

Thanks — Tessa

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@horizonpay.com>
Cc: HorizonPay Security <security@horizonpay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 15:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service continuity follow-up — accountability sprint & customer brief

Hi Liam — thank you for the questions and the window offer. Below is a consolidated response and our proposed next steps.

1) Data handling confirmation
- We verified that no request payloads were written to cross-tenant or public logs. During the window, debug-level traces were produced to an internal, tenant-scoped debug bucket that is access-controlled. We have provided a redacted subset in the evidence-logs.tar.gz. If you need full packet traces we require a quick amendment to our standard data-sharing NDA; happy to initiate that.

2) Exact timestamps and scope
- Affected window (UTC): 2028-06-29T03:04:05Z through 2028-06-29T03:26:18Z.
- Affected session IDs (sampled): s-7f9a2b, s-7f9a2d, s-7f9a31, s-7f9a5e (we've included a larger set in the attachment).

3) Hotfix acceleration request
- Feasibility: Dylan confirms we can prioritize a tenant-targeted hotfix that applies the conservative autoscale gating policy to HorizonPay only. Risk: minimal change surface; we will run a targeted canary across a small set of HorizonPay traffic before full application.
- Proposed maintenance window: Sat, 7 Jul 2028 02:00–03:00 UTC (low traffic for your region).
- ETA: We can ship the hotfix and run the canary within 7 days if you approve the window.

4) Commitments recap (what we will deliver)
- Hotfix & targeted canary (7 days): conservative autoscale gating pinned to your tenant during scale operations (Owner: Dylan Brooks).
- 30-day deliverable (but started immediately): expanded test coverage and regression test for autoscale race conditions (Owner: Neha Kapoor).
- 90-day deliverable: tenant-aware post-scale stability options in Console (Owner: Marissa Cole).

Next steps for HorizonPay
- Reply to confirm the maintenance window (Sat, 7 Jul 2028 02:00–03:00 UTC) and whether you want us to proceed with the 7-day hotfix.
- If you require full packet traces, indicate and we will start the NDA amendment.

Attachments included: updated service-timeline.xlsx (annotated with session IDs), evidence-logs.tar.gz (redacted), and the customer-communication-draft.docx (Marissa's non-technical summary). Drive link and DocuSign link above.

Happy to jump on a 20-minute call if you'd prefer a verbal walk-through.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Senior Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference
